guard_order: write32 saved on every normal exit

leaves.name: compare
leaves.normal_result: 0 on initial null/count0 or first mismatch; 1 if all count bytes equal full32 A1
leaves.normal_register_effect: A0 advances before each LBU and is finally overwritten by 0 or 1; A3/A4/A5 scratch. No own SP/RA/GP/S writes/calls.

leaves.name: fill
leaves.normal_result: initial destination on null/count0; otherwise uint32(destination+count), not libc memset return
leaves.normal_register_effect: A0 advances before each SB; low8 A1 is written. A4/A5 scratch. No own SP/RA/GP/S writes/calls.

leaves.name: copy
leaves.normal_result: unchanged initial destination; forward read-before-write loop, not memmove snapshot semantics
leaves.normal_register_effect: A0/A1/A2 unchanged; A3/A4/A5/A6 scratch. No own SP/RA/GP/S writes/calls.

fresh reads and each byte store remain ordered; MMIO alias is observable
